description: Updates a calendar list entry's display/subscription settings (color, visibility, reminders, selection) for the authenticated user — does not modify the underlying calendar resource (title, timezone, etc.). To modify the calendar itself, use googlecalendar.calendars_update.

backgroundColor.human_parameter_description: Pick the background color for this calendar in hex (e.g., #0088aa) to help you visually distinguish it in your calendar view.
backgroundColor.title: Background Color

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. Must be an actual calendar ID (e.g., "examplecalendar@group.calendar.google.com" or "c_abc123...@group.calendar.google.com"). To retrieve valid calendar IDs, use the googlecalendar.list_calendars action first. The "primary" alias is not valid for calendarList.update.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: The calendar you want to update. Use GOOGLECALENDAR_LIST_CALENDARS to find valid calendar IDs (look for the 'id' field in the results).
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

colorId.description: ID for calendar color from colors endpoint.
colorId.human_parameter_description: Choose a color by its ID from Google's calendar color palette. This is a quick way to set a theme without entering a hex code.
colorId.title: Color Id

colorRgbFormat.description: Whether to use RGB for foreground/background colors.
colorRgbFormat.human_parameter_description: If true, treat color values as RGB hex codes when updating colors. Turn this on when you’re specifying foreground/background hex values.
colorRgbFormat.title: Color Rgb Format

defaultReminders.human_parameter_description: Set the default reminders that will apply to new events on this calendar, such as email or popup alerts and how many minutes before the event.

method.description: Method for the reminder (e.g., email, popup).
method.title: Method

defaultReminders.title: Default Reminders

foregroundColor.human_parameter_description: Pick the text/icon color for this calendar in hex (e.g., #ffffff) so events stay readable against the background.
foregroundColor.title: Foreground Color

hidden.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to hide this calendar from your calendar list. Hiding won’t delete it—just removes it from view.
hidden.title: Hidden

notificationSettings.human_parameter_description: Control which notifications you receive for this calendar (for example, event creations or changes) and how they are sent.
notificationSettings.title: NotificationSettings

selected.description: Whether calendar content shows in UI.
selected.human_parameter_description: Decide if events from this calendar should appear on your calendar view. Unselect to keep it in the list but not overlay its events.
selected.title: Selected

summaryOverride.human_parameter_description: Enter a custom name for this calendar as you want it to appear in your list (e.g., ‘My Work Calendar’).
summaryOverride.title: Summary Override

name: calendar_list_update

accessRole.description: The effective access role that the authenticated user has on the calendar. Possible values are: "owner", "writer", "reader", "freeBusyReader".
accessRole.title: Access Role

backgroundColor.description: The main color of the calendar in the hexadecimal format "#0088aa".
backgroundColor.title: Background Color

colorId.description: The color of the calendar. This ID refers to an entry in the colors definition (colors collection).
colorId.title: Color Id

defaultReminders.description: The default reminders that the authenticated user has for this calendar.
defaultReminders.title: Default Reminders

deleted.description: Whether the calendar has been deleted from the calendar list. Only present if true.
deleted.title: Deleted

description.description: Description of the calendar, if provided.
description.title: Description

display_url.description: Direct URL to view this calendar's settings page in Google Calendar web UI.
display_url.title: Display Url

foregroundColor.description: The foreground color of the calendar in the hexadecimal format "#ffffff".
foregroundColor.title: Foreground Color

hidden.description: Whether the calendar has been hidden from the calendar list.
hidden.title: Hidden

location.description: Location associated with the calendar, if provided.
location.title: Location

notificationSettings.description: The notifications that the authenticated user is receiving for this calendar.
notificationSettings.title: Notification Settings

primary.description: Whether the calendar is the primary calendar of the authenticated user. Only present if true.
primary.title: Primary

selected.description: Whether the calendar has been selected for viewing by the authenticated user.
selected.title: Selected

summaryOverride.description: User-specified name of the calendar displayed in the UI. If present, it overrides the calendar's summary.
summaryOverride.title: Summary Override

timeZone.description: The time zone of the calendar (IANA time zone identifier).
timeZone.title: Time Zone

method.description: The method used to deliver the notification. Possible values include "email" ("sms" is deprecated and may be ignored).
method.title: Method

type.description: The type of notification. Possible values are: "eventCreation", "eventChange", "eventCancellation", "eventResponse", "agenda".
type.title: Type

allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.description: The types of conference solutions that are allowed for the calendar.
allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.title: Allowed Conference Solution Types

method.description: The method used by this reminder. Possible values include "email" and "popup".
method.title: Method

minutes.description: Number of minutes before the start of the event when the reminder should trigger.
minutes.title: Minutes

notifications.description: A list of notifications set for this calendar.
notifications.title: Notifications
